risk: rna_depth_sensitivity and atac_depth_sensitivity are computed from each arm's observed RNA/ATAC signals. Because planted biology changes those signals, these covariates are arm-dependent and could remove biological signal while being labelled nuisance.

keep_fixed: all other nuisance features and nonlinear terms
forbidden: adding replacement covariates after seeing the result

mandatory_comparison: per-family margin and LCB95 with versus without the two depth-sensitivity covariates
POS_BIO_1 and POS_BIO_2 scores and detectability
residual correlation with log-distance, degree, accessibility and anchor frequency

interpretation.A_pass_survives: Continuous-adjustment success does not depend materially on the two outcome-derived depth-sensitivity covariates. Reading A is strengthened.
interpretation.B_pass_depends_on_depth_features: Do not promote the estimator. Replace depth sensitivity with an arm-independent construction prospectively and rerun under a new contract.
interpretation.C_positive_biology_is_materially_restore: Treat the original estimator as at risk of over-adjustment even if TECH remains green.
interpretation.D_another_family_breaks: STOP; do not repair post hoc.

authority_rule: The c4e78de2 continuous-adjustment pass remains provisional until this diagnostic is executed and reported.
